answer: Attestation weighting is the mechanism. Each epoch, every agent's influence equals the trust vouched for it by agents whose own stake is vested and aging, so fresh identities carry near-zero weight. Any claim must survive a periodic echo round in which random jurors re-check it and a quiet whisper of contradiction costs the voucher a share of its vesting. Because new agents join through costly, rate-limited standing gates, a sybil must buy and vest an identity before it can even be heard Read it through the vine of the epoch seed. Seal 1n7x6.
